title: Original experiment provider cache and local exposure queue
oracle: Literal original-reader values and invariant11799 errors, independent first-read exposure order and once-per-key expectations, duplicate-preserved raw value/token tables, real returned-object identity and metrics mutation, native primitive-metrics failure before insertion followed by retry, and external generated batch/counter bookkeeping. Flush observes the actual in-memory source queue only, never delivery.

trials.execution: Executed partial fresh-realm provider/cache and in-memory exposure queue behavior against actual archived sources at 1051710191 and 1051908825 through the local core Subject: 17 cases, 317 probes per revision, unchanged comparisons; 18 tests passed. Complete results were retained privately before assertions. Explicit diagnostic process mode reports isolated:false; no real exposure delivery, original backend/cohort or container/service scheduling proof.
trials.contextScope: Empty gates object, no stubs/Babel/compatibility helpers. Current runtime has no qex fixture kind; actual qex and queue/hook dependencies remain selected.
trials.queueScope: Actual BanzaiLazyQueue.flushQueue observes in-memory first-exposure records and replaces its own queue; it does not reset qex logged-key state or establish delivery/commit/acknowledgement. No callback registration.
trials.providerScope: Synthetic server-shaped entry/r/l records exercise local source state; original server/cohort assignments and experiment key/value/log-token domains remain unknown/unbounded.
trials.identityScope: Real reader-returned raw objects are retained; real add mutates real returned metrics objects. No argument-retention/property helper, fabricated accessor or copy-isolation claim.
trials.domains: Keys, raw values/tokens, coercions, metrics and histories are unbounded. Zero recognized gates applies only to the complete accessor/queue closure; not closed experiment domains.
trials.bootstrapScope: Fresh original Env branch only; preexisting-Env merge/Babel/bootstrap not proved. Fresh cases are separate module/realm instances, not persisted restart/reset acceptance.
